metaTitle: Electrician Advertising: Google Ads, LSA and Meta
metaDescription: Electrician advertising from ASP: Local Services Ads, Google Search Ads by service, EV charger ad groups, Meta retargeting and hiring, tracked to booked jobs.

hero.h1: Electrician Advertising Tracked to Booked Jobs
hero.subhead: Reach homeowners who need an electrician today and buyers planning a charger install. ASP runs Local Services Ads, Google Search and Meta, with accounts in your name.
points: Ad spend paid straight to Google and Meta

why.heading: Why Google treats electrical calls as urgent
why.intro: Google treats electricians as an urgent Local Services Ads category, because people often call for time-sensitive problems like exposed wiring and critical electronic failures. That buyer wants a phone number, not an article.

cards.title: Answered phones, not wasted clicks
cards.body: We set ad schedules and budgets around the hours your team can pick up. An ad that rings an unanswered phone is spend with nothing to show for it.

cards.title: Planned work, separate ad group
cards.body: EV charger installs get their own ad group and landing page, so a planned job isn't judged on the same cost as an emergency call.

cards.title: Commercial work, its own budget
cards.body: A service call and a commercial project can support very different costs per job, so they run on separate budgets.

services.heading: What ASP runs for electrician advertising

cards.title: Local Services Ads
cards.body: Pay per lead instead of per click. We manage the listing against profile signals Google weighs, including rating, reviews, response time and verification checks.

cards.title: Google Search Ads
cards.body: One ad group per service or service area, phrase match, and new negative keywords every week, so each electrical service shows its own cost per job.

cards.title: Meta retargeting
cards.body: Brings back people who read your service pages and didn't call, and keeps your name familiar in your service area before they need you.

cards.title: Meta recruiting
cards.body: The electricians you want usually already have jobs and aren't browsing job boards, and Meta reaches them. Recruiting has its own budget, apart from lead spend.

cards.title: Call and job tracking
cards.body: Tracking is fixed before bids change. The conversion action stays on the lead you sell, and Housecall Pro users can send booked revenue back to Google Ads.

steps.title: Tracking before bids
steps.body: Calls, forms and bookings get tracked to the lead you sell before a single bid changes.

steps.title: Start where you qualify
steps.body: If your reviews support it, Local Services Ads are usually where we start, with Search running alongside.

steps.title: Build by service
steps.body: Search goes in one ad group per service, with residential repairs, EV chargers and commercial work kept apart.

steps.title: Tune every week
steps.body: Negative keywords get added weekly, and each service is judged on its own cost per job.

pricing.heading: Ad management for electrical contractors
pricing.subhead: Paid media management is included from Growth up, covering your Local Services Ads, Search campaigns and Meta for electrical work. Spend goes straight to the platforms.

faqs.question: Are Local Services Ads worth it for electricians?
faqs.answer: If you qualify and your reviews hold up, LSA is usually where we start, and you pay per lead rather than per click. Search Ads still run alongside it, since LSA inventory is capped per metro and Search can target each electrical service directly.

faqs.question: How does an electrician get approved for Local Services Ads?
faqs.answer: Google screens every business before ads run. Once you're approved, we manage Local Services Ads as its own channel, and Google now calls its badge Google Verified.

faqs.question: How much should an electrician spend on ads?
faqs.answer: Work back from what a booked job is worth to you. An emergency service call, an EV charger install and a commercial project can each support a different cost per job, so each is judged on its own. Ad spend is separate from ASP's fee.

faqs.question: Will Facebook ads bring in emergency electrical calls?
faqs.answer: Not reliably, and we won't sell them that way. Someone smelling a burning outlet searches Google right then. Meta earns its place by bringing back site visitors who didn't call and by recruiting electricians.

faqs.question: Do I own my ad accounts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your Google Ads, Local Services Ads and Meta accounts are set up in your name, and ASP never collects, holds or marks up what you spend. The what-you-own page lists everything else that stays yours.

cta.heading: Put your ad spend behind booked jobs
cta.body: Show us your current accounts, or start fresh. We'll map which electrical services to advertise, how to split residential and commercial, and how each call gets tracked.
